notes.title: Game Update 1.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Our latest game update has just launched! This new patch focuses on enhancing shop customization and town aesthetics, aiming to sprinkle more color and joy into your gameplay. Dive into the update highlights below:
🏡 Fresh Shop Customization Styles:

    Broader Flooring Selection: Transform your shop's look with two new flooring colors – the inviting Pink and the tranquil Sky Blue. Step beyond the classic brown and personalize the shopping environment, making it a truly unique space for every visitor.

🌸 Town Beautification Project:

    Decorative Additions: We've introduced an array of new decorative features throughout the town, including charming little flowers, to invigorate every corner with life.
    Tree Aesthetic Upgrade: Our trees have received a careful facelift, now boasting colors and details that more closely reflect our artistic vision.
    Monster Visual Rework: We've artistically updated several monsters, now depicted in richer, more vibrant colors.

notes.title: 1.4.1 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Cloud Save Sync Fix
We've addressed the recent issue where cloud saves were not syncing properly with the new version. Your game progress should now synchronize seamlessly.

Enhanced Interaction Feedback
In response to your feedback, we've implemented a couple of enhancements to improve the item selection process and minimize inadvertent item usage:

    Audible Confirmation on Item Switch: You will now receive an audible cue when switching items, to confirm the system has registered your selection.
    Visual Confirmation with Cursor Icon: To help you track which item you have selected, the icon of the currently active item will now appear beside your cursor.

notes.title: 🌟 Brand New Gaming Experience - Major Update 1.4.0 Announcement! 🎉
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

🛠 The brand-new furniture crafting bench is now live!
 In your early gaming experience, you can now access the furniture crafting bench, enabling you to create a variety of furnishings that will beautify your space. We've also introduced a range of innovative decorative items to add more life to your environment!

🏭 Discover the charm of handcrafted goods! 
We've introduced new facilities like the grinding mill and pickling barrel, where you can produce essentials like flour, oil, white sugar, and magical essences, or pickle veggies and cheeses. Take these ingredients to the cooking bench and whip up delicious meals!

🎯 Battle gear upgraded! 
We've added materials for crafting frisbees, darts, and powerful monster-summoning scrolls to your arsenal. These items offer new ranged attack options for your battles.

🗺 Dungeons expanded to 100 floors! 
We've doubled the dungeon depth from 50 to 100 floors. As you go deeper, you'll need to acquire maps to unlock new challenges. The monsters and treasures on every floor have been fine-tuned to ensure a surprise-filled adventure.

🏝 Set sail for new island dungeons! 
After mastering the 100-floor challenge, a far-traveling ship will ferry you to uncharted islands. Seven brand-new island dungeons await you, including the mysterious Endless Island, where the adventure never stops.

🛡 New choices in ore-based equipment! 
At the forge, you can now transform various ores into equipment, providing a greater variety of battle gear and strategic options.

🔨 A brand-new tool bench! 
Craft battle items and building materials to add more utility to your adventures.

🤖 The vending machine has arrived! 
Once you reach a certain depth in the dungeon, you can purchase blueprints and construct vending machines to automate your item sales, freeing you from managing sales yourself.

👾 Monster AI comprehensively enhanced! 
We've overhauled monster AI, fine-tuned their stats, and made them smarter and more engaging. Some monsters have new appearances, and we've introduced fresh types. The difficulty of stage bosses has been ramped up, but fear not—the new combat items at your disposal are more than up to the task.

🏃‍♂️ Action Feel Optimized!
We've smoothed out the attack animations and rolling movements, making the controls more responsive and intuitive. The feedback when mining ores and chopping trees has been enhanced to give a more satisfying sense of impact.

🎨 Visual Experience Enhanced!
The game's visuals have received a comprehensive upgrade with redrawn textures and a revamped user interface. We've also refined the details of characters and environments for an even more immersive experience.

🌟 The Squirrel Wishing Fountain!
Try your luck by tossing in a golden hazelnut and you might receive an unexpected reward. Sometimes it might just be a stone, but that's the whimsy of adventure, right?

📜 Plot and Dialogue Revitalized!
We've enriched the game's narrative by rewriting the dialogue and adding new quests. These will draw you deeper into our world and help you grasp the gameplay mechanics more quickly.

🎮 UI Experience Enhanced
Item equipping is now seamless with the new drag-and-drop feature, and you can scroll through items on the toolbar with the mouse wheel—no longer confined to just the number keys. We've also improved various aspects of UI feedback to make your game interactions as smooth as silk.

🔨 Shop Expansion Upgraded
You can now expand your shop three times, giving you two additional expansion opportunities compared to before! For the second expansion, you'll need a new material—stone bricks. These bricks, craftable at the workstation, will not only enlarge your shop but will also make it more attractive to customers.

· Summoned Beast 'Bomo' Update
The Bomo is no longer granted by default at the start of the game. Now, you will acquire a Bomo after completing the initial jungle challenge and from the guild leader. Once Bomo reaches level 5, it will stop selling goods automatically, and we have recalibrated its damage growth to be more balanced.

· Item and Building Price Adjustments
We've reassessed the prices of certain items and the costs to unlock buildings to ensure a more balanced economy within the game.

· Nighttime Lighting Fix
We've resolved a bug that caused flickering lights and graphical stuttering during nighttime, ensuring a smoother experience after dark.

· Time System Improvements
The in-game days have been lengthened, and each season now spans 28 days, providing you with more time to immerse yourself in the game.

· Rabbits Added to the Farm
Rabbits are now available for purchase on your farm. These cute creatures produce two pieces of animal fur each day, creating a new revenue stream for your farm business.

· Environment Level Affects Customer Traffic!
Enhancing your environment level will now draw more customers to your store.

· Market Upgrade
The market has been significantly improved and is now open only on Sundays, eliminating the frustration of making the trip and finding little to buy.

· Storage Box Capacity Increased
To improve resource management, the capacity of storage boxes has been increased.

· Bomb Damage Adjusted
We've reduced the damage received by the player from bombs while keeping their damage to monsters unchanged.

· Time Display Optimized
Time will now be displayed in AM/PM format, and we've added a clock feature to aid with time management.

Regarding Save Compatibility:
Due to extensive updates that have changed the save file structure, old saves will not be compatible with the new version of the game. If you wish to continue playing the old version, you can do so by following these steps:
· In the Steam client, right-click the game and select "Properties."
· In the Properties menu, navigate to the "Betas" tab.
· Use the dropdown menu to select "oldVersion1.3.0" and revisit the previous game version, where your existing saves will still be valid.
· To switch back to the latest version, simply select "None - Opt out of all beta programs."
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, but we are confident these updates will enhance your gaming experience. Should you encounter any issues or require help during this transition, please don't hesitate to contact us at SuperluminalCat@foxmail.com.

💖 We sincerely appreciate your understanding and support.

Superluminal Cat

notes.title: Update Schedule Revision for the Game
notes.content:
Dear Valued Players,

We have some important information to share about the forthcoming update to our game. This update is so substantial, effectively tripling the game's original size, and involves a wealth of new text that needs localization. As a result, we've decided to move the initially planned release from November to early December.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience that this rescheduling might cause you. However, we assure you that this extra wait will yield a significantly enhanced gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding and continued patience.
SuperluminalCat

notes.title: April 19,2021 Update V1.3.0
notes.content:
1. Added a day and night system, and residents will turn on warm street lights at night. You can feel the nightfall more intuitively, and it's time to go home and sleep.
2. The character customization interface has been redrawn. The previous interface was ugly, so we re-drawn one, and now you can designing  the character on a piece of paper under a desk lamp.
3. Change the drop rate of some items.
4.Fixed the "Bomb" achievement. Added the achievement "Kill the Evil Crystal".
5.Some translations in German are localized: buttons, food, gems, objects. Thanks to Lunarwingz for helping us  improve the German translation-extremely grateful.

notes.title: March 2,2021 Update V1.2.0
notes.content:
1.Fix bug: The upgraded cooking table and pots may disappear after reading the file.
2.When fighting, it may not be smooth to walk along the wall. Now we have smoothed the wall.
3.In previous versions, you had to click the arrow to continue the conversation, which was inconvenient. Now click anywhere in the dialog box to continue.
4.Added 5 Steam Achievements.
5.Added 4 shopping NPCs.
6.Cooking requiring crab has been removed.
7.A local German player is helping us to improve the German translation, and the German will be localized in the next patch update.

notes.title: February 2,2021 Update V1.1.0
notes.content:
1. The number of baits is displayed when fishing. You don't have to open the backpack to check the bait while fishing.
2. The picture of the Gacha has been replaced. The Gacha is now a gift box.
3. 12 kinds of hairstyles and 3 kinds of clothes have been added. There are more styles to change.
4. Added 5 kinds of shopping NPC with different appearance. It reduces the chance of NPC with the same appearance.
5.Fix bug: The hens sold by ranchers move too fast. Now it's back to normal walking speed.

Only the EA version has been updated now, the Demo version has not been updated yet.

notes.title: 20.11.04Update
notes.content:
1. Added iron counter, gold inlaid counter and gem counter. More goods can be placed, and more environmental values can be added.
2. When the weapon is equipped, the weapon in the character's hand will also be replaced.
3. Polar wolf, snow monster and firefly monster have been added to the monster forest.
4. Elf system. The elf can assist the character in battle. The attributes that can be increased by feeding the elves are more handy in battle.

notes.title: A Little Shop in Squirrel Town
notes.content: "A Little Shop in Squirrel Town" is an RPG-type Simulation Game. You will become the owner of a grocery store in Squirrel Town. Kill monsters and make equipment, Raise pets and fish, make new commodities, and become the richest businessman in Squirrel Town.

notes.title: 10.7 Update
notes.content:
1. Plot guide
2. Add frying pan, boiling pan and grilling functions to the cooking table.
3. Gem making station: It can be inlaid with equipment gems.
4. New crops: sugarcane, strawberry, tomato, greens, pepper, wheat.


The demo version is currently only available in Chinese, and other languages are still in production.
